whenToUse: Editor formatting controls that stay pressed, such as bold, italic, underline and strikethrough
Reaction and save controls, such as like, retweet, share and bookmark, with or without a count
Media and app controls with an on and off state, such as mute, pin to sidebar or a notifications bell

whenNotToUse.when: A one time action such as Save, Send or Delete that keeps no pressed state
Related actions joined edge to edge into one strip, such as playback or zoom controls
A set of options read as one value and crossed with arrow keys, such as text alignment

agentNotes: Pressed state lives inside each `Toggle` or a local `useState` and nothing saves it; read changes from `onPressedChange` to persist them
Every `Toggle` here is named by `aria-label`, which wins over its visible text for screen readers, so update both when relabelling
